name: Sacubitril + Valsartan
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated. Do not give within 36 hours of switching from or to an ACE inhibitor.

key_interactions.effect: Duplicate ARB: sacubitril/valsartan already contains valsartan (label).

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated in diabetes; avoid if eGFR below 60.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements, salt substitutes

key_interactions.effect: Worse kidney function, possible acute kidney failure in older, volume-depleted or CKD patients (label).
